purpose: User-authorized rerun with cubic gain nonlinearity multiplied by3 and explicit harmonic suppression; no learning retuning.
physical_case: Static matched auxiliary; new assumed stronger cubic truth; ideal flash/CDAC/SAR; no noise or dynamics

training.rng: numpy.default_rng PCG64; generate entire input and then entire two-column dither record before chunking
training.method: full120, all 120 observations selected; both banks simultaneously commit after slot119; next sample uses new banks
training.chunk_contract: Static analog only. Chunks end at complete120 windows. Each implementation carries its OWN eight coefficients; local counters are aggregated offline. No residual/window state is lost at these boundaries.

test.policy: Same coherent tone and fixed dither at all checkpoints; freeze the independently learned banks; no adaptation during test

scoring.primary: Original floating corrected output; raw branch is original integer reconstruction
scoring.additional_integer: Offline-only clip(floor(output+0.5),0,4095), explicitly labeled; no change to model arithmetic
scoring.fft: Existing analyze_coherent_tone; rectangular coherent FFT, remove DC, SNDR all nonfundamental nonDC power, SFDR largest spur, harmonics2..5 for SNR/THD; full_scale_peak2048
scoring.paper_comparison: This is a harmonic visualization test at97.75390625MHz, not the1GHz chip measurement. Do not compare absolute scores with the previous different-frequency test.

preflight: 480-conversion record: continuous run versus two240-conversion chunks for both implementations; compare physical/digital outputs and after banks exactly. Then compare all original-core and native-model traces.

acceptance.field_limits: Reuse python_reference.tolerance; all scalar fields of all conversions retained and compared, plus independently carried checkpoint banks
acceptance.performance: Outcome only; keep this seed, steps and horizon even if improvement is small or paper numbers are not reached
acceptance.source_unchanged: Original Python platform/calibration and adc_behavioral.slx must retain recorded hashes

sources.parameters_and_steps: New cubic coefficients are assumed3x stress conditions; original steps fromEXP057. No source, model or learning algorithm modification.
sources.paper_scope: Public accepted author manuscript text; local publisher PDF and rendered original figures unavailable

harmonic_analysis.zoom_selection: Largest BEFORE odd harmonic amongHD3..HD31; keep the same bin after calibration, never select by suppression
harmonic_analysis.thd_policy: Additional THD2..31 distinct from original metrics THD2..5; explicit folded bins and dBFS/dBc before/after/suppression; also retain integer results
harmonic_analysis.expectation: Odd-symmetric cubic compression is expected to create odd harmonics; quantization and fixed finite dither may leave even harmonics. Outcomes, including any worsened harmonic, are retained.
harmonic_analysis.monotonicity: dg/dz=a+3*b*z^2; positive on declared domain[-1,1], minimum0.480 and0.620
